title: GhostAPI-V: Evaluating Audited Diagnostics for Internal API Migration Repair
abstract: arXiv:2611.33396v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: API migrations require callers to adopt target-version usages while removing incompatible legacy usages. GhostAPI-V represents these obligations as human-audited temporal contracts and supplies candidate-specific repair diagnostics, with correctness assessed by independent behavioral tests. We evaluate 48 internal migrations from eight Python repositories using Claude Code and Codex, with two initial runs per agent and task. Five revision arms branch from the same 192 initial candidates, controlling generation budget, version evidence, and development-test feedback. Hidden-test success is 120/192 (62.5%) for raw version-difference feedback, 130/192 (67.7%) for required-only contracts, and 148/192 (77.1%) for full bidirectional contracts. Full feedback improves over raw version-difference feedback and required-only feedback by 14.6 and 9.4 percentage points, respectively. translated_title: GhostAPI-V：评估用于内部API迁移修复的经审计诊断方法
translated_abstract: API迁移要求调用方采用目标版本的用法，同时移除不兼容的旧版本用法。GhostAPI-V将这些义务表示为经人工审计的时序契约，并提供针对候选方案的修复诊断信息，其正确性由独立的行为测试进行评估。我们使用Claude Code和Codex对来自八个Python代码库的48个内部迁移进行评估，每个智能体与任务各进行两次初始运行。五个修订分支从相同的192个初始候选方案出发，控制生成预算、版本证据和开发测试反馈。隐藏测试的成功率分别为：原始版本差异反馈120/192（62.5%），仅必需项契约130/192（67.7%），完整双向契约148/192（77.1%）。完整反馈相比原始版本差异反馈和仅必需项反馈分别提升了14.6和9.4个百分点。包级别效应在所有八个代码库中均为正向，并且……
tldr: GhostAPI-V提出以经人工审计的时序契约为API迁移修复提供候选诊断，实验证明完整双向契约反馈可将隐藏测试成功率从62.5%提升至77.1%。
en_tdlr: GhostAPI-V provides human-audited temporal contract diagnostics for API migration repair, and experiments show that full bidirectional contract feedback lifts hidden-test success from 62.5% to 77.1%.
